intent.proves: The buyer persona exists as exactly one sign-in (login) row under its user name: the build's buyerUserName, or TruvioBuyer when the build names none.
intent.scope: AccessUser rows with the buyer's user name that are the login of that user name (AccessUserIsLogin); the sample data also ships a second, non-login row under the name

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUser WHERE AccessUserUserName = N'{buyerUserName}' AND AccessUserIsLogin = 1
